offerings.name: Search / Web Search API
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results (rounded up); plans: Free 1,000 credits/mo $0, Hobby 5,000 credits/mo $16/mo billed annually ($19/mo monthly), Standard 100,000 credits/mo $83/mo, Growth 500,000 credits/mo $333/mo, Scale 1,000,000 credits/mo $599/mo; pay-as-you-go extra credits: Hobby 1,000 credits/$5, Standard 2,000 credits/$5, Growth 2,500 credits/$5, Scale 5,000 credits/$5.
offerings.price_basis: Hobby pay-as-you-go extra credits (1,000 credits per $5; search costs 2 credits per 10 results)
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（标题、描述、URL；可含图片/新闻结果；可选 scrapeOptions 抓取全文 markdown/HTML/links）
offerings.note: gov 类别搜索不计搜索 credits；ZDR：匿名 2 credits/10 结果，端到端 10 credits/10 结果；scrapeOptions 另计 credits；限额与并发依套餐。
